_head: (Promulgated by Order No. 11 of the Ministry of Information Industry of the People’s Republic of China on 10 May 2001, effective from the date of promulgation. Amended pursuant to the Decision of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology on Repealing and Amending Certain Rules, promulgated by Order No. 28 of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology of the People’s Republic of China on 23 September 2014.)

_chapters.第三章 进网许可证和进网许可标志: Chapter III  Network Access Licences and the Network Access Licence Mark

第一条: Article 1  These Measures are formulated in accordance with the Telecommunications Regulations of the People’s Republic of China in order to ensure the security and smooth operation of the public telecommunications network, to strengthen the administration of network access of telecommunications equipment, and to protect the lawful rights and interests of telecommunications users and telecommunications business operators.
第二条:
Article 2  “Telecommunications equipment” in these Measures means telecommunications terminal equipment, radio communications equipment and equipment involved in network interconnection.

“Telecommunications terminal equipment” means telecommunications equipment connected at the termination of the public telecommunications network that provides users with the function of sending and receiving information.

“Radio communications equipment” means telecommunications equipment connected to the public telecommunications network that uses radio as its means of communication.

“Equipment involved in network interconnection” means telecommunications equipment involved in interconnection and interoperability between the networks of different telecommunications business operators, or between the networks of different telecommunications services.
第三条:
Article 3  The State operates a network access licensing system for telecommunications terminal equipment, radio communications equipment and telecommunications equipment involved in network interconnection that is connected to the public telecommunications network.

Telecommunications equipment subject to the network access licensing system must obtain a network access licence issued by the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology; equipment that has not obtained a network access licence may not be connected to or used on the public telecommunications network, nor sold within the country.
第四条: Article 4  The catalogue of telecommunications equipment subject to the network access licensing system shall be formulated and published by the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology together with the product quality supervision department of the State Council.
第五条: Article 5  A telecommunications equipment manufacturer (hereinafter “manufacturer”) applying for a network access licence for telecommunications equipment must comply with national laws, regulations and policy requirements. Telecommunications equipment for which a network access licence is applied for must conform to national standards, communications industry standards and the provisions of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology. A telecommunications equipment manufacturer shall have a sound quality assurance system and after-sales service arrangements.
第六条:
Article 6  A manufacturer applying for a network access licence for telecommunications equipment shall attach a test report issued by a telecommunications equipment testing body recognised by the product quality supervision department of the State Council, or a product certification certificate issued by a certification body.

The basis on which a testing body tests telecommunications equipment for which a network access licence is applied for, the testing procedures, and the test report issued shall conform to the provisions of the State or of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology.
第七条:
Article 7  The Telecommunications Administration Bureau of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology is specifically responsible for the administration, supervision and inspection of network access of telecommunications equipment nationwide.

The communications administrations of the provinces, autonomous regions and directly governed municipalities are responsible for the administration, supervision and inspection of network access of telecommunications equipment within their respective administrative areas.

Acceptance bodies authorised by the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology undertake the specific acceptance of applications for network access licences for telecommunications equipment.
第九条: Article 9  Within 60 days of the date on which the acceptance body receives complete application materials, the Telecommunications Administration Bureau of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology shall examine the application materials submitted by the manufacturer; where the examination finds the conditions to be met, it shall issue a network access licence and grant the network access licence mark; where the conditions are not met, it shall reply to the manufacturer in writing.
第十条:
Article 10  Where a manufacturer has obtained quality system certification, it shall itself select, in the prescribed quantity, the samples it provides to a testing body for testing.

Where a manufacturer has not obtained quality system certification, the samples it provides to a testing body for testing shall be drawn by the communications administration of the province, autonomous region or directly governed municipality in accordance with the sampling method prescribed by the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology.
第十一条:
Article 11  Radio communications equipment, equipment involved in network interconnection, or a new product for which a network access licence is applied for shall undergo a trial of at least three months on a telecommunications network within China or on a simulated test network designated by the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, and the testing entity shall issue a trial report.

The Telecommunications Administration Bureau of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology shall organise experts to review the overall technical plan, trial report, test report and other materials for the telecommunications equipment referred to in the preceding paragraph; on the basis of the expert review opinions, where examination finds the conditions to be met, a network access licence shall be issued.
第十二条:
Article 12  Where a manufacturer makes technical or external-form modifications to telecommunications equipment that has obtained a network access licence, testing must be carried out or a network access licence must be obtained anew.

Where the external-form modification to telecommunications equipment that has obtained a network access licence is minor and the manufacturer requests a reduction or waiver of test items, it may submit photographs before and after the modification, circuit schematics, a description of the modification and samples after the modification to a testing body for review. The testing body shall issue its review opinion to the Telecommunications Administration Bureau of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology; where the testing body’s review concludes that test items may be reduced or waived, such reduction or waiver may be made with the consent of the Telecommunications Administration Bureau of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology.
第十三条:
Article 13  For new telecommunications equipment that is subject to the network access licensing system but for which no national or industry standard yet exists, the manufacturer shall itself send samples to a testing body, which shall test them against international standards or enterprise standards and issue a test report.

The Telecommunications Administration Bureau of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology shall examine the test report and related materials and, on condition that national industrial policy is complied with and the security and smooth operation of the network is not affected, shall approve a network access trial; a network access licence shall then be processed in accordance with the procedures once a national or industry standard has been promulgated.
第十四条: Article 14  Where China has concluded with the government of another country or region an agreement on the mutual recognition of telecommunications equipment testing laboratories and test reports, the agreement shall be implemented in accordance with its terms.
第十五条:
Article 15  A manufacturer shall affix the network access licence mark to telecommunications equipment that has obtained a network access licence. The network access licence mark shall be printed and issued uniformly by the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology. The network access licence mark is a quality mark.

The network access licence mark may not be affixed to telecommunications equipment that has not obtained a network access licence or whose network access licence has lapsed.
第十六条: Article 16  A network access licence and the network access licence mark may not be transferred, altered, forged or used fraudulently.
第十七条:
Article 17  A network access licence is valid for three years.

Where a manufacturer needs to continue to produce and sell telecommunications equipment that has obtained a network access licence, it shall apply anew for a network access licence three months before the expiry of the licence’s validity period, attaching a sample test report or a product quality supervision spot-check report from within the preceding year, and shall return the original licence.
第十八条: Article 18  Where the content specified in a telecommunications equipment network access licence changes, the manufacturer shall obtain a network access licence anew.
第十九条: Article 19  A manufacturer that has obtained a network access licence shall provide photocopies to its distributors and to users who require a photocopy of the licence; the photocopy shall be signed by the person in charge of the manufacturer and bear the official seal. The manufacturer shall number and register the photocopies.
第二十条: Article 20  A manufacturer shall state the network access licence number on the packaging of telecommunications equipment that has obtained a network access licence and in any advertisements it publishes.
第二十一条:
Article 21  The Ministry of Industry and Information Technology shall periodically publish to the public the telecommunications equipment and manufacturers that have obtained network access licences.

A manufacturer that has obtained a network access licence shall submit to the supervision and administration of the communications administration of the province, autonomous region or directly governed municipality in which it is located.

No entity may conduct repeat testing of, or issue a further certificate for, telecommunications equipment that has already obtained a network access licence.
第二十二条: Article 22  The communications administration of each province, autonomous region and directly governed municipality shall, before 31 December each year, conduct an annual inspection of the telecommunications equipment and manufacturers within its administrative area that have obtained network access licences, and shall, before 31 January of the following year, compile and report the results of the annual inspection to the Telecommunications Administration Bureau of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology.
第二十三条:
Article 23  A manufacturer that has obtained a telecommunications equipment network access licence shall ensure the consistency of the telecommunications equipment before and after it obtains the network access licence, shall ensure that product quality is stable and reliable, and may not reduce the quality or performance of the product.

The Ministry of Industry and Information Technology shall organise supervision and inspection of the consistency of telecommunications equipment before and after it obtains a network access licence; it shall cooperate with the product quality supervision department of the State Council in quality tracking and supervisory spot checks of telecommunications equipment that has obtained a network access licence, and shall publish the results of such spot checks to the public.
第二十四条: Article 24  Telecommunications equipment that has obtained a network access licence and its outer packaging must bear the Chinese-language markings prescribed by the State; the product must be accompanied by Chinese-language instructions and a warranty card; for products for which the State requires guaranteed repair, replacement and return, the corresponding documentation shall also be provided.
第二十五条: Article 25  Where telecommunications equipment subject to the network access licensing system has not obtained a network access licence, a telecommunications business operator may not use it.
第二十六条: Article 26  Users have the right to choose telecommunications terminal equipment independently, and a telecommunications business operator may not refuse a user the use of their own telecommunications terminal equipment that has obtained a network access licence.
第二十七条: Article 27  A telecommunications equipment testing body or product quality certification body must implement national standards, industry standards and the provisions of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology. A testing body or product quality certification body and its staff may not engage in fraud or falsification, and may not exploit their position to plagiarise or disclose a manufacturer’s technical secrets.
第二十八条: Article 28  Where, in violation of these Measures, a party sells telecommunications terminal equipment that has not obtained a network access licence, the communications administration of the province, autonomous region or directly governed municipality shall order rectification and impose a fine of not less than RMB 10,000 and not more than RMB 100,000.
第二十九条: Article 29  Where, in violation of these Measures, a party forges, fraudulently uses or transfers a network access licence, fabricates a network access licence number, or affixes a forged network access licence mark, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology or the communications administration of the province, autonomous region or directly governed municipality shall confiscate the unlawful gains and impose a fine of not less than three times and not more than five times the unlawful gains; where there are no unlawful gains or the unlawful gains are less than RMB 10,000, a fine of not less than RMB 10,000 and not more than RMB 100,000 shall be imposed.
第三十条: Article 30  Where, in violation of these Measures, a manufacturer reduces the quality or performance of a product after obtaining a network access licence, the product quality supervision department shall impose penalties in accordance with the relevant laws and regulations.
第三十一条: Article 31  Where, in violation of these Measures, a manufacturer fails to state the network access licence number on the outer packaging of licensed equipment and in advertisements it publishes, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology or the communications administration of the province, autonomous region or directly governed municipality shall order rectification and issue a warning.
第三十三条: Article 33  Where, in violation of these Measures, a telecommunications business operator refuses network access to a user’s own telecommunications terminal equipment that has obtained a network access licence, the communications administration of the province, autonomous region or directly governed municipality shall order rectification, an apology to the telecommunications user and compensation for the user’s losses; where the operator refuses to rectify, apologise and compensate, a warning shall be issued together with a fine of not less than RMB 10,000 and not more than RMB 100,000; where the circumstances are serious, suspension of business for rectification shall be ordered.
第三十四条: Article 34  Where, in violation of these Measures, repeat testing is conducted of, or a further certificate issued for, telecommunications equipment that has already obtained a network access licence, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology shall order rectification.
第三十六条: Article 36  Where personnel engaged in the acceptance, testing, approval and related work for telecommunications equipment network access licence applications abuse their powers, engage in favouritism and malpractice, or exploit their position to plagiarise or disclose a manufacturer’s technical secrets, administrative sanctions shall be imposed in accordance with law. Where a crime is constituted, criminal liability shall be pursued in accordance with law.
第三十七条: Article 37  Measures for the administration of the seismic performance of telecommunications equipment entering the public telecommunications network shall be formulated separately by the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology.
第三十八条: Article 38  For telecommunications equipment not subject to the network access licensing system, a manufacturer may apply voluntarily for product certification to a telecommunications equipment network access certification body recognised by the product quality supervision department of the State Council.
第三十九条: Article 39  These Measures take effect from the date of promulgation. The Measures for the Administration of Network Access Approval of Telecommunications Equipment, promulgated by the Ministry of Information Industry on 31 December 1998, are repealed at the same time.
